thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired to @oncall-sre — spike in auth-service JWT validation failures (500s). rule: auth.jwt.validation.rate > 5% for 5m

pagerduty: Pager (PD-67890) — triggered for team: infra-auth. Incident link: https://pd.example/INCIDENT/PD-67890

alex: acked via PagerDuty — looking now. any customer-facing impact yet?

priya: seeing a surge of `invalid_signature` errors from our token-verify lambda in eu-west-1. logs show KID mismatch for a subset of tokens. attaching snippet: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T11:02:27Z","error":"invalid_signature","kid":"old-key-rotated"}```

mike: confirming — JWKS endpoint returned mixed keys for a short window 10:57:xx -> 11:00:05. possibly propagation delay from key rotation job.

emily: customers reporting auth failures on session refresh flows, severity medium. creating incident ticket in Zendesk and tagging CSMs.

dave: does the console show rollout of new signing key around 10:56? I see a deploy marker but need to confirm whether key push to KMS completed.

alex: quick mitigation: enable signing fallback to previous key for 30m and re-route verification to fallback cache for 15m. executing runbook step now: `/runbook auth/fallback-signing enable --reason "post-rotate KID mismatch"`

incident-bot: runbook action started by alex: fallback-signing enabled in prod. Notifying downstream caches.

priya: rolling a small hotfix to jwks-syncer to tolerate missing KID during 60s windows — will push a canary to eu-west-1 only. command: `deploy jwks-syncer --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --canary=2`

mike: creating temporary alert suppression for the validation-rate rule for eu-west-1 while we stabilize, will keep global alerts live. suppressing 10m.

emily: CSM update drafted: "We observed short-lived token validation errors affecting session refresh for some EU users; mitigation in progress; no token theft risk; next update in 30m." sending now.

alex: PagerDuty escalation plan: if not resolved in 15m escalate to SRE lead @dave and oncall secondary. current assignee alex (ack).

dave: on my way. if fallback restores traffic we need to schedule a safe re-rotate with zero-downtime JWKS swap and confirm KMS key policy propagation.

priya: can confirm canary looks stable after 3 minutes — no invalid_signature events on canary nodes. promoting to full rollout in 2m.

mike: validation-rate now down to 0.8% in eu-west-1, globally 0.6%. trending back to normal.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-67890: acknowledged by alex; status: mitigated (partial) — monitor for 30m.

emily: support ticket #INC-22456 created and linked to PD-67890. Notifying top impacted customers: ACME, NovaHealth, ZephyrApps.

alex: follow-ups: 1) postmortem to include exact key-rotation timeline and why JWKS propagation lagged; 2) add KID-stability grace window in token-verify; 3) run scheduled KMS propagation test next week.

dave: agreed. I'll own the postmortem. assigning to me and priya. ETA for writeup: EOD tomorrow.

customer-support-bot: automated note posted to affected tickets: "Authentication errors observed March 15; service restored. Engineers are investigating root cause; we will follow up with details."

alex: closing PD incident once no regressions for 30m. great work everyone. :thumbsup:

priya: leaving a final note: added more robust logging around `kid` mismatch and improved metric to surface KID churn during rotations.

mike: removing suppression in 8m. monitoring dashboards for 60m.

incident-bot: thread marked with tag: auth-outage, paging, mitigated.
